metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in New Mexico in July 2016 higher than in any other July over the past 30 years?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# New Mexico polygon from coordinates
nm_coords = [[-109.050, 37.000], [-103.002, 37.000],
             [-103.002, 31.334], [-109.050, 31.334]]
nm_geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon(nm_coords)

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing Function
def get_july_mean_temp(year):
    """Get mean skin temperature for New Mexico in July of given year."""
    start = f'{year}-07-01'
    end = f'{year}-07-31'
    
    col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') \
          .filter(ee.Filter.date(start, end)) \
          .select('skin_temperature')
    
    # Check collection size
    size = col.size().getInfo()
    if size == 0:
        print(f'{year}: No data (C1)')
        return None
    
    # Compute monthly mean image
    mean_img = col.mean()
    
    # Get mean temperature over region
    result = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=nm_geometry,
        scale=50000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    temp = result.get('skin_temperature').getInfo()
    
    # Count valid pixels
    count_img = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=nm_geometry,
        scale=50000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    pixel_count = count_img.get('skin_temperature').getInfo()
    
    return {'temp': temp, 'pixels': pixel_count}

# 3. Process all years
temps = {}
failed = False

print("Processing July temperatures (1986-2016):")
for year in range(1986, 2017):
    data = get_july_mean_temp(year)
    if data is None:
        failed = True
        break
    
    temp_k = data['temp']
    temp_c = temp_k - 273.15  # Convert to Celsius for readability
    
    # Validate temperature range
    if temp_k is None or temp_k < 200 or temp_k > 350:  # ~-73°C to +77°C reasonable
        print(f'{year}: Invalid temp {temp_k:.1f}K (C3)')
        failed = True
        break
    
    temps[year] = temp_k
    print(f'{year}: {temp_c:.1f}°C ({data["pixels"]} px)')

# 4. Check for processing failures
if failed:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # 5. Comparison logic
    temp_2016 = temps[2016]
    other_years = [y for y in range(1986, 2016)]
    other_temps = [temps[y] for y in other_years]
    
    max_other = max(other_temps)
    max_year = other_years[other_temps.index(max_other)]
    
    print(f"\n2016 July: {temp_2016-273.15:.1f}°C")
    print(f"Max other: {max_other-273.15:.1f}°C ({max_year})")
    
    # Final decision
    if temp_2016 > max_other:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
